verdict.rationale: ADK provides a built-in dev/Web UI for testing and debugging agents and 'Callbacks' to hook into execution lifecycle events (tool calls, steps), which implies some event-level visibility, but the evidence never explicitly documents a token-streaming API or SSE/websocket mechanism for piping live model tokens and intermediate events to a custom developer UI. missing for 10: explicit streaming API docs (e.g., run_live/streaming endpoint), example of real-time token streaming to a custom UI, confirmation that tool-call/step events are exposed via a streaming interface rather than just the built-in debug UI.
